STRATEGY: The parent is a forgiving TFT-like strategy that forgives rare defections, retaliates against repeated defections, and tries to break DD cycles. The trace simulates it against the archive probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) starting from ten externally supplied CC rounds. It proposes changes: more aggressive exploitation of always-cooperators, better DD-cycle breaking, and endgame defection.

STRATEGY: The parent is a generous TFT-style strategy with endgame defection, always-defect/always-cooperate detection, forgiveness when opponent cooperation rate is high, and exploitation of always-cooperating opponents. The trace simulates the parent against controlled probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and against a slot-6 strategy. It changes the strategy by adding an alternating-pattern break that returns C when last_me != last_opp, prev_me != prev_opp, and last_me != prev_me, to escape D/C alternation against TFT-like opponents.
